body: It seems confusing now to me that you can click once and get the property editor or click twice and get the same info at the node/card for the activity. I think possibly we should get rid of the cards ...but maybe move to a system where we show more of what is on the property editor. Like maybe the activity by default can show all the emissions ....or the first 5 or 10 ..... but I dont think we should have the same info on teh acdtivity card and in the activity property editor.

comments.body: If we made the property editor always showing when teh graph view is current, then we can put the "Structure" vs "Scaled" view on that property editor window. We could put buttons there for what to show on the activity card for each node maybe, like do we want to show inputs and outputs in detail or emissions in detail, something like that.
I think we need to redesign the property editor and the activity cards.
